label: Town of Greensboro
header:
# Town of Greensboro municipal roster backfill -- Vermont
# municipal fan-out batch 10; issue #163 (VT master tracking).

sources.note: Town of Greensboro Selectboard page (greensborovt.gov): lists the sitting board with terms: Ellen Celnik to 2028, Tim Brennan to 2028, Mike Metcalf to 2027, Judy Carpenter to 2029, and the Chair, whose term runs to 2027 and who is styled only by the surname MacNeil in every official source -- the town report's officers table, the board's minutes, and the town contact page alike. The Chair's seat is left unfilled rather than minted on a partial name; the 2026 Warning stood exactly the two seats (Celnik's and Carpenter's) whose printed terms the page updates.
Town of Greensboro Selectboard minutes, September 9, 2026 (greensborovt.gov): the board sits as MacNeil (Chair), Ellen Celnik, Tim Brennan, Mike Metcalf, and Judy Carpenter.

Town of Greensboro 2026 Town Report (greensborovt.gov): the officers table seats Timothy Nisbet as Moderator on a one-year term that expired at the March 2026 meeting, and the 2026 Warning stood the office for one year. Structure only: the outcome is published in no official source read. Nisbet is minted below as a justice of the peace on the SOS listing.
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, & County Clerks' (January 2026): lists Kim Greaves as Greensboro town clerk.

Town of Greensboro 2026 Town Report (greensborovt.gov): the 2026 Warning, Article 1, stood the clerkship for a three-year term at the March 2026 meeting and Greaves signed the warning as Town Clerk; she also appears in the Selectboard's September 9, 2026 minutes. Structure only: the town publishes no outcome for a seat its own warning stood, so the incumbent is not minted on directory currency alone.
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, & County Clerks' (January 2026): lists Brett Stanciu as Greensboro town treasurer.

Town of Greensboro 2026 Town Report (greensborovt.gov): the treasurer appears in neither the 2026 Warning's elective articles nor the report's elected-officers table; the clerk's report welcomes Stanciu back 'as Zoning Administrator and Treasurer,' and the town contact page names her to the office. Recorded as an appointment to a town office.

Town of Greensboro 2026 Town Report (greensborovt.gov): the officers table seats Mike Cloutier as Collector of Delinquent Taxes on a one-year term that expired at the March 2026 meeting (Warning Article 17 proposed making the Treasurer the collector; its outcome is likewise unpublished). Structure only.

Town of Greensboro 2026 Town Report (greensborovt.gov): the town's Selectboard Appointments list names Mark Snyder as Constable. Recorded as an appointment; the constable is not in the warning's elective articles.

Town of Greensboro 2026 Town Report (greensborovt.gov): the officers table seats Peggy Lipscomb to 2027 and Sherral Lumsden to 2028; no 2026 article stood a third seat, and the third seat is left unfilled.

Town of Greensboro 2026 Town Report (greensborovt.gov): the officers table seats six elected trustees of the Greensboro Free Library: Valerie Carter to 2028, Galen Fisher to 2028, Jennifer Lucas to 2027, and Fan Watkinson to 2027 are minted; the seats of Carol Reynolds (one-year) and Jan Terwiesch (three-year) stood at the March 2026 meeting under the warning's library articles and their outcomes are unpublished, so those seats are unfilled. The table's two alternates are not trustees.
Town of Greensboro 2026 Town Report (greensborovt.gov): the officers table seats Patsy Mercier to 2027 and Wayne Young to 2028; the third seat (MacNeil's) stood in 2026 and is unfilled.
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, '2025-2026 Vermont Justices of the Peace' listing (updated December 4, 2025): lists five justices of the peace for Greensboro.
Town of Greensboro 2026 Town Report (greensborovt.gov): the report's Board of Civil Authority block names the same five.

sources.note: Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, '2025-2026 Vermont Justices of the Peace' listing (updated December 4, 2025): the SOS listing names the five Greensboro winners of the November 5, 2024 justice of the peace election.
